en-US.author: Element Labs, Inc.
en-US.description: An AI agent for working with open models locally and in the cloud.
en-US.longDescription: LM Studio Bionic is an AI agent for coding, research, and document work with local or cloud-hosted open models.
en-US.name: Bionic
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Faster file suggestions in large projects.
- Faster loading of long side chats.
- Better UI treatment for runtime download progress numbers.
- Consistent sidebar alignment when no sessions exist.
- Session approvals carry over to forks.
- Fixed blurry terminal text at fractional display scales.
- Fixed app updater redownloaded unnecessarily.
- Fixed composer suggestions changing selection before the mouse moves.
- Fixed chat template parsing for Flint models.
- Fixed Mac updates reopening the current version instead of installing the update.
- llama.cpp 2.67.0 extension packs.
- oMLX 0.1.0 engine for Apple Silicon Macs.
